role.zh: 数字影像设计师 / CG Artist

intro.en: A portfolio of CG objects, creature studies, cinematic image design, and scanner-based visual experiments. The work moves between hard-surface modeling, organic forms, render lookdev, and image direction.
intro.zh: 这里展示 CG 道具、怪物形体、电影感影像设计与扫描实验。作品围绕硬表面建模、有机形体、渲染风格开发和影像方向展开。

availability.en: CG visual development, product/object rendering, creature concept images, cinematic key visuals, and image post-production.
availability.zh: CG 视觉开发、产品/道具渲染、怪物概念影像、电影感主视觉与影像后期。

subtitle.en: Cinematic vehicle renders with high-saturation motion, industrial details, and graphic title frames.
subtitle.zh: 高饱和电影感载具渲染，结合工业细节、运动感和标题画面。

description.en: A CG image series inspired by cyberpunk vehicle culture. The set balances close material reads, frame-like compositions, and a noisy digital finish for a cinematic portfolio sequence.
description.zh: 一组受赛博朋克载具文化启发的 CG 影像。系列在材质近景、电影分镜式构图和数字噪点质感之间取得平衡，形成完整的作品集序列。

credits.en: Owner: Kaneua / Producer: HOSIZOYg / Render: Blender
credits.zh: Owner: Kaneua / Producer: HOSIZO / Render: Blender

subtitle.en: Creature surface exploration with pearlescent shells, wet membranes, and repeated body fragments.
subtitle.zh: 怪物表面研究：珍珠质外壳、湿润膜结构和重复身体切片。

description.en: A creature lookdev set focused on bulbous volume, translucent highlights, and unsettling repetition. The images are arranged like specimen plates rather than single hero shots.
description.zh: 以膨胀体积、半透明高光和不安的重复结构为重点的怪物 lookdev。画面更像标本图版，而不是单张英雄图。

credits.en: Creature modeling, material study, render composition
credits.zh: 怪物建模、材质研究、渲染构图

subtitle.en: Hard-surface prop rendering with weathered paint, metal plates, stickers, and close-up material reads.
subtitle.zh: 硬表面道具渲染，包含旧化漆面、金属铭牌、贴纸和材质近景。

description.en: A prop visualization study designed around tactile wear, dense mechanical surfaces, and a strong silhouette that still reads in extremely wide compositions.
description.zh: 围绕可触摸的磨损感、密集机械表面和强轮廓展开的道具可视化研究，即使在超宽构图中也能保持识别度。

subtitle.en: Material and lighting passes for a sculptural figure with museum-like stillness.
subtitle.zh: 带有博物馆式静止感的人像雕塑材质与灯光渲染。

description.en: A compact render set studying controlled highlights, clay-like surfaces, and the shift between object documentation and editorial image.
description.zh: 一组紧凑的渲染研究，关注可控高光、泥塑般的表面，以及物件记录与编辑影像之间的转换。

credits.zh: 灯光、材质调试、渲染选片

subtitle.en: A single-frame character render for silhouette, fabric volume, and atmospheric framing.
subtitle.zh: 围绕角色轮廓、服装体积和氛围构图展开的单帧渲染。

description.en: A character image built for immediate read: strong posture, broad clothing mass, and a restrained background to keep the figure central.
description.zh: 一张强调快速识别的角色影像：明确的姿态、大块服装体积和克制背景，让人物成为视觉中心。

subtitle.en: Scanner-based image experiment with saturated floral texture and flatbed depth.
subtitle.zh: 以扫描仪为基础的影像实验，强调饱和花卉纹理和平板景深。

description.en: A tactile image study using the scanner as a camera, preserving compressed depth, dust, and color intensity as part of the final image language.
description.zh: 把扫描仪当作相机使用的触感影像研究，保留被压缩的空间、灰尘和高饱和色彩，作为最终语言的一部分。

credits.zh: 扫描、色彩处理、影像编辑
